comparison: Only candidate to pass all 3/3 14,000-update 100-mode continuations and five_word_joint_smoke, tying unified-v3 at 13/18 overall Tier-3 passes at 30% lower compute (4215.0s vs 6060.7s), but fails mode_hold quality threshold.
conclusion: On the untouched Tier-3 long-horizon holdout view (seed 0, zero tuning, 4215.0s), t4-arch-v3 passed 13/18 tasks including ALL THREE 14,000-update fresh-process native continuations with zero degradation (grid100 0.9816/0.3312 -> grid100_14k 0.9839/0.3313; rotated100 0.9825/0.3124 -> rotated100_14k 0.9837/0.3327; staggered100 0.9833/0.2990 -> staggered100_14k 0.9863/0.3282), best zero_tanh_rail_escape (0.0011 MAE), and the sole five_word_joint_smoke PASS (561.1s, 5/5 words, exact=1). It failed 2 tasks: five_word_joint_hold (dropped apple at step 7334, 4/5 words, exact=0) and mode_hold (8/8 modes, hq=0.8308 < 0.90, gating ring_hold, ring_extension, and target_shift_recovery).
